body.name: Eight-leaf exact certificate for the worked instance
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal T_{3,5}\) start at \((\varnothing,\{c_1,c_2,c_3,c_4,c_5\},\varnothing)\), branch on the least-index element of \(E\), and encode inclusion by \(1\) and exclusion by \(0\). Its leaves are \(111\), \(1101\), and \(0111\), justified by \(|I|>2\), together with \(1100\), \(10\), \(0110\), \(010\), and \(00\), whose exact optimistic-descendant bounds are respectively \(1/2\), \(1/8\), \(1/8\), \(1/6\), and \(1/4\). The incumbent is \(S^{\star}=\{c_1,c_4\}\) with claimed value \(v^{\star}=1/8\).
